summary: Teck Resources filed a Form 6-K press release updating its proposed merger of equals with Anglo American plc, originally announced September 9, 2025. The parties agreed the period between fulfilment of remaining non-Effective Date conditions and completion will be 11 trading days, with the merger effective time expected at 10 p.m. Vancouver time on the eleventh trading day. Anglo American must declare a special dividend of approximately US$4.5 billion as a condition, now payable within 45 days of the effective date instead of 30. The filing updates dividend timing and closing logistics; watch for completion conditions and regulatory approvals.
